artists.biography: Mark James Morriss (born 18 October 1971 in Hounslow, Middlesex) is an English singer-songwriter, formerly the lead singer for The Bluetones who split up in September 2011 following a farewell tour. He is the older brother of former bandmate and bass player/illustrator Scott Morriss and is currently pursuing a solo career.

perplexity.description:
A Flash of Darkness is the second solo album by Mark Morriss, released in 2014 through the Acid Jazz label. Following the disbandment of his band and his 2008 debut solo album Memory Muscle, this record continues Morriss’s exploration of rock with a refined, melodic style that blends introspective songwriting and textured arrangements. The album features a mix of thoughtful lyrics and accessible rock instrumentation, maintaining Morriss’s characteristic vocal delivery and songwriting sensibility.

Positioned in Morriss’s discography as a mature follow-up to his debut, A Flash of Darkness was initially funded via a Pledge campaign before its official release by Acid Jazz. It received positive critical attention for its cohesive sound and Morriss’s ability to craft engaging rock songs with emotional depth. While not a major commercial breakthrough, the album solidified his reputation as a solo artist capable of delivering quality rock music beyond his earlier band work.
